# Introducción

Este documento presenta un resumen descriptivo de las variables numéricas del conjunto de datos
**Dht22 + PM + Piranómetro** (temperatura, humedad, material particulado y radiación solar).

# Funciones auxiliares

```{r funciones}
resumen <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        where(is.numeric),
        list(
          N           = ~ n(),
          `Valid (n)` = ~ sum(!is.na(.x)),
          Min         = ~ round(min(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Q1          = ~ round(quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Median      = ~ round(median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Mean        = ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Q3          = ~ round(quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Max         = ~ round(max(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          `Missing (n)` = ~ sum(is.na(.x)),
          `Missing (%)` = ~ round((sum(is.na(.x)) / n()) * 100, 2)
        ),
        .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
      )
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = c("Variable", "Estadistico"),
      names_sep = "__"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Estadistico,
      values_from = value
    )
}

tabla_bonita <- function(x, caption = NULL, digits = 2) {
  x %>%
    kable(
      caption = caption,
      digits = digits,
      format.args = list(big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ","),
      align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(x) - 1))
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
      full_width = TRUE,
      position = "center",
      font_size = 13
    ) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#2c3e50") %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
}
```

# Carga de datos

```{r carga}
df <- read_csv("/kaggle/input/datasets/diegorestrepoleal/measurement-of-t-h-pm-and-radiation/Dht22_PM_Piranometro.csv")
```

El conjunto de datos tiene **`r format(nrow(df), big.mark = ".")` filas** y
**`r ncol(df)` columnas**.

## Vista previa

```{r vista-previa}
df %>%
  head(10) %>%
  tabla_bonita(caption = "Primeras 10 observaciones") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%")
```

## Estructura de las variables

```{r estructura}
tibble(
  Variable = names(df),
  Tipo     = map_chr(df, ~ class(.x)[1]),
  `NA (n)` = map_int(df, ~ sum(is.na(.x)))
) %>%
  tabla_bonita(caption = "Tipo de dato y valores faltantes por variable", digits = 0)
```

# Resumen estadístico

## Tabla estática

```{r resumen-estatico}
res <- resumen(df)

res %>%
  tabla_bonita(caption = "Resumen estadístico de las variables numéricas") %>%
  column_spec(
    which(names(res) == "Missing (%)"),
    color = "white",
    background = spec_color(res$`Missing (%)`, option = "D", end = 0.8, direction = -1)
  ) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%")
```

## Tabla interactiva

Se puede ordenar, filtrar y exportar.

```{r resumen-interactivo}
datatable(
  res,
  rownames = FALSE,
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options = list(
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    pageLength = 15,
    scrollX = TRUE
  ),
  caption = "Resumen estadístico (interactivo)"
) %>%
  formatRound(columns = setdiff(names(res), "Variable"), digits = 2)
```

# Distribución de las variables

```{r histogramas, fig.height=7}
df %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Valor") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Valor)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#2c7fb8", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribución de las variables numéricas",
    x = NULL, y = "Frecuencia"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
